انصبنا (form VII)
# اِنْصَبَنَا (inṣabanā) /in.sˤa.ba.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# اِنْصَبَنَّا (inṣabannā) /in.sˤa.ban.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# اِنْصَبِنَا (inṣabinā) /in.sˤa.bi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
